# tools.nyuchi.com
#
# Most of this site is behind the AuthKit login gate (see mcp/src/index.ts) and
# is neither reachable nor useful to a crawler. Only the outward-facing product
# and legal pages are public, so those are the only ones allowed here.
#
# Longest-match wins for the major crawlers, so the specific Allow lines take
# precedence over the blanket Disallow below them.

User-agent: *
Allow: /calendar-overlay
Allow: /calendar-overlay/privacy
Allow: /legal/privacy
Allow: /legal/terms
Disallow: /
